findings.title: Words saved from reader, dictionary or Words list are never served in Study (88 stranded cards, 6 learners, since 2026-07-02)
findings.refs: src/sessionPrep.js:116-160 (state 'new' rows enter startedVocab, excluded from newItems); src/studyAvailability.js:35-43 (only learning/relearning/review are due); src/srs.js:175-177; inserters useStoryReaderCore.js:408, StoryReaderImmersive.jsx:546, Dictionary.jsx:193, Words.jsx:59, dict_add_to_deck
findings.fix_direction: Serve saved 'new' cards (reps 0, no prior claim) as new items ahead of curriculum vocab, within the daily new allowance; stop counting them as 'introduced today' until first graded.
findings.acceptance: Unit spec: a saved card appears in the next session; e2e: save word in reader → Flashcards shows it; prod count of stranded cards trends to 0 after release.

findings.title: Offline: grading a brand-new card twice queues a write with a 'local-…' card id that fails uuid cast forever; graduation lost, outbox never drains
findings.fix_direction: Resolve local ids to (vocab_id) upsert path on replay or coalesce writes per vocab; treat 22P02 as a permanent failure with a visible recovery rather than infinite retry.
findings.acceptance: Audit harness appendices/harnesses/sync.test.js flushes 2/2; offline e2e: grade new card twice, reconnect → outbox empty, server reps 2.

findings.title: TestFlight lane blocked: Apple Program License Agreement not accepted by the Account Holder; last good build 2026-08-16
findings.fix_direction: Account Holder accepts the latest PLA in the Apple Developer portal; re-run iOS build → TestFlight.
findings.acceptance: A green ios-testflight run from main; new build visible in App Store Connect.

findings.title: Android store build has no VITE_SUPABASE_URL/ANON_KEY → app would open on 'Site can't start'; no signed AAB has ever been produced
findings.fix_direction: Mirror the iOS env + bundle-contains-URL guard; wire the upload keystore secret; fail when unsigned.
findings.acceptance: android-build run produces a signed AAB whose bundle contains the Supabase URL; app signs in on a device.

findings.title: Store builds ship the web bundle (build:public), not build:native: apps fetch Google Fonts on launch, contradicting /privacy ('apps never contact Google')
findings.fix_direction: Use npm run build:native in both store workflows; pin it in native-ci-contract.test.mjs; add the store-bundle no-Google check to the store workflows.
findings.acceptance: Store workflow logs show build:native; verify-native-fonts passes on the shipped dist; contract test fails if reverted.

findings.title: HSK 3-6 flashcards teach wrong/proper-noun senses (页 'xié head', 孙子 'Sun Tzu', 成功 'Chenggong town', 联想 'Lenovo', 友好 'Youhao district', …); ~32 capitalised readings + ~15 proper-noun-only meanings
findings.refs: public.vocabulary (prod); docs/BACKLOG.md:448 (marked applied: readings only); src/tts/sources.js:16-34
findings.milestone: public (Must verify for beta at HSK3+)
findings.fix_direction: Scripted detection (capitalised readings, district/county/city/proper-noun glosses) → curated corrections committed as a migration → Chinese reviewer sign-off → only then regenerate affected audio.
findings.acceptance: Detector query returns 0 rows; reviewer signs the changed list; spot list above correct in prod.

findings.evidence_type: suspected (cannot verify without reading auth rows)
findings.title: No evidence an App Review demo account with a reachable story and review session exists
findings.fix_direction: Owner creates a dedicated reviewer account seeded (Creative Mode) so a story and due reviews are reachable; record in review notes.
findings.acceptance: Fresh install → sign in with reviewer creds → reach a story and a review in <2 min.

findings.title: Daily studied count is sent as an absolute from a per-session counter; later sessions, second tab or midnight overwrite it (24/168 user-days below review-log totals)
findings.fix_direction: Send 'increment' deltas with op-id dedupe (already idempotent via review_logs) or derive day counts from review_logs.
findings.acceptance: Harness: 20 grades then 3 grades → 23; prod mismatch query trends to 0 for new days.

findings.title: 'Mastered' reachable after two self-rated Easy presses (day 6); recap 'You learned your first N words' counts Again and calibration grades
findings.refs: src/knowledgeState.js isMastered; src/Words.jsx:29; src/studyTally.js newLearned; src/SessionRecap.jsx:281
findings.fix_direction: Rename to 'long-term' / require ≥N successful reviews over ≥X days for the 'Mastered' label; recap counts only non-Again first grades. Level test (30/30) unchanged.
findings.acceptance: Spec: two Easy presses do not yield 'Mastered'; recap copy matches METRICS.md definition.

findings.title: Reader shows each word's single stored reading regardless of context (地 ground→'de' ~40×, 长 zhǎng→cháng ~8×, 行 xíng→háng ~4×); screen pinyin can disagree with narration
findings.fix_direction: Per-token reading overrides from the authored/utterance pipeline (which already has context fixes) with fallback to vocab reading; at minimum a polyphone override table for the listed cases.
findings.acceptance: Re-run harnesses/poly-audit.mjs → 0 known polyphone mismatches; reviewer spot check.

findings.title: 3,305 active HSK 3-6 words have no word audio (L3 383, L4 631, L5 986, L6 1304)
findings.fix_direction: After HD-AUD-006 reading fixes, run the per-level tts-flashcards pass; keep graceful silent state meanwhile.
findings.acceptance: Count of active HSK3-6 words without ready audio = 0 (or documented exclusions).

findings.title: Android hardware Back exits the app at '/', which also hosts ~7 onboarding steps, auth, tour and Home dialogs — answers lost
findings.fix_direction: Let in-screen state (onboarding step, open dialog/sheet) consume Back first via a registered handler stack; exit only from Home idle.
findings.acceptance: Unit spec for backAction with overlay/step state; device: Back steps through onboarding.

findings.title: Revealed flashcard clips the hanzi and cannot scroll to it on short viewports; iOS target declares iPad + iPhone landscape with no testing
findings.fix_direction: Beta: restrict to iPhone portrait (or test iPad). Public: use margin:auto centring inside the scroller so overflow is reachable.
findings.acceptance: Screenshot at 568×320 and 640×400 shows the hanzi; iPad decision recorded.

findings.title: Dark mode study grade buttons use hard-coded light pastels (interval text 2.3:1) and raw accent pinyin (2.94:1) — violates token/ink() rules
findings.fix_direction: Token-ise the grade palette with dark variants; wrap accent text in ink().
findings.acceptance: axe color-contrast passes on Study back in dark mode.

findings.title: Chinese text lacks lang='zh-Hans' on flashcard, shelf, Words, Profile, Landing; card front aria-label hides the hanzi
findings.fix_direction: Apply langAttr() wrapper on every CJK text node; drop overriding aria-label.
findings.acceptance: lang scan script (evidence/ux/scripts/langscan.mjs) reports 0 untagged CJK runs on main screens.

findings.title: Word popover never receives focus, not aria-modal; its actions come after every word in tab order
findings.fix_direction: Focus after visibility toggles (rAF/after layout); dialog semantics; restore focus to token on close.
findings.acceptance: evidence/ux/scripts/sheetfocus.mjs: focus lands in sheet; Escape returns to token.

findings.title: Play-required web deletion page (/support) lacks what is deleted/retained and retention period; review notes cite /profile
findings.fix_direction: Owner supplies backup-retention window; publish the drafted copy; align review notes.
findings.acceptance: Page lists deleted data, retained data, retention; Play Console deletion URL set.

findings.title: No release-cut discipline: store builds dispatchable from any branch without green-CI/tag gate; version hard-coded 1.0; Android signing silently falls back to unsigned
findings.fix_direction: Restrict dispatch to main/tags, require CI success on the SHA, auto-increment build number, fail unsigned release builds; write the cut procedure.
findings.acceptance: Dispatch from a feature branch is refused; build numbers monotonic; procedure doc exists.

findings.title: Backup/PITR, restore and rollback unproven; prod migration history (29) can't reproduce schema from repo (68 files, different timestamps); no uptime check
findings.fix_direction: Record plan/PITR; perform one restore drill into a scratch project; write web rollback (Vercel promote) + DB forward-fix policy; add uptime ping.
findings.acceptance: Restore drill log; rollback section in DEPLOY.md; schema diff of repo-built vs prod is empty or documented.

findings.title: grade_card / RLS / delete_my_account are only regex-tested against SQL text; CI has no Postgres
findings.fix_direction: Add a supabase-local or pg service job running pgTAP/SQL tests for grade_card idempotency, RLS cross-user denial, delete_my_account cascade.
findings.acceptance: CI job executes SQL tests and fails on a seeded regression.

findings.title: Dojo HQ invite-code holders can author the prompt launched into Claude Code on the maintainer's PC; bridge --self-update executes unsigned code fetched from the HQ site; worker workspace creation unauthenticated
findings.fix_direction: Pin/sign bridge updates (hash from repo), require explicit local confirmation before launch, authenticate workspace creation. Mitigation present: Claude launched in manual permission mode.
findings.acceptance: Self-update refuses unsigned payload; launch shows local confirmation.

findings.title: Reader 'Add to deck' failures are silent (no error, no outbox), logic duplicated in two readers; an already-in-deck word cannot be sent back to review
findings.fix_direction: Extract one tested addToDeck module with error feedback and outbox use; decide (product) whether 'still hard' marks an existing card for earlier review.
findings.acceptance: Spec: failed insert surfaces a toast; offline add replays; single implementation.

findings.title: Custom-scheme deep link com.hanzidojo.app:/\evil.com maps to '/\evil.com' → falls back to location.assign → opens attacker URL in system browser; react-router 7.17 has GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6 (high per npm audit)
findings.fix_direction: Reject paths containing backslash or '//' in deep-link mapping; upgrade react-router(-dom) past 7.18.1.
findings.acceptance: Spec for nativeShell rejecting backslash paths; npm audit --omit=dev clean.

findings.title: Sign-out does not clear IndexedDB; the stories offline snapshot (cards, reads, unlocks, recent reviews) is not user-keyed and is visible offline to the next account
findings.fix_direction: Key snapshots by user id and clear all offline stores on sign-out/account switch.
findings.acceptance: e2e: user A signs out, user B offline sees none of A's data.

findings.title: Web host sends no CSP, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options or Referrer-Policy (signed-in app frameable)
findings.fix_direction: Add headers block (frame-ancestors 'none', Referrer-Policy, conservative CSP report-only first).
findings.acceptance: curl -I shows headers; app still loads fonts/audio/YouTube.

findings.title: Leaked-password protection disabled; minimum password length 6
findings.fix_direction: Enable HIBP check; raise min length to 8+ (client + Auth config).
findings.acceptance: Advisor clean; signup rejects a known-breached password.

findings.title: feedback.message/context unbounded; feedback.email client-supplied (spoofable)
findings.fix_direction: Length CHECKs; derive email server-side.
findings.acceptance: Oversized insert rejected.

findings.title: Anonymous analytics inserts have no rate limit (rows bounded) — dashboard metrics can be inflated
findings.fix_direction: Edge rate limit or session-scoped caps; dashboard notes the limitation.

findings.title: All progression gates trust the client for the user's own rows (cards reps/stability, level_unlocks, story_unlocks, current_level); CLAUDE.md §3b not DB-enforced; creativeMode.js writes reps (admin)
findings.fix_direction: Accept for a free single-player app; document as accepted risk; keep server-side gates on the roadmap.
findings.acceptance: Decision recorded.

findings.title: Unrelated 'BodyOS' app table shares the Supabase project/auth pool (0 rows); delete_my_account also deletes BodyOS data; privacy text silent; 3 auth users without a profile (cause unknown); PRIVACY-AUDIT.md contradicts itself (:274 vs :1250)
findings.fix_direction: Owner decides: drop the BodyOS objects or move BodyOS to its own project; investigate the 3 profile-less users.
findings.acceptance: Decision recorded; table absent or disclosed.

findings.title: dict_add_to_deck global cap (500/day) vs per-user 200: three free accounts can block new dictionary words for everyone for a day
findings.fix_direction: Raise global cap or scope it to new-account age; alert when hit.

findings.title: Local dojo-bridge accepts no-Origin requests and doesn't check Host (DNS-rebinding read of status/ROADMAP/TASKS)
findings.fix_direction: Check Host is 127.0.0.1/localhost; require Origin on non-GET.

findings.title: ~40 tag-pinned actions, some workflow_dispatch inputs interpolated into shell (write-access only), 4 workflows without permissions:
findings.fix_direction: SHA-pin, env-indirect inputs, default permissions: read.

findings.title: Default broad grants to anon (RLS blocks), pg_net/pg_trgm in public, empty duplicate 'Audio' bucket, buckets without size/MIME limits, RLS-no-policy backup tables
findings.fix_direction: Clean up in one hygiene migration.
findings.acceptance: Advisor WARNs reduced.

findings.title: Grade buttons show 1 min / 6 min / 10 min but learning cards are re-queued by position (documented design) — labels misdescribe behaviour
findings.fix_direction: Label as 'again soon' / 'later this session' or honour time.
findings.acceptance: Copy matches behaviour.

findings.title: Level-test 3-attempts/day resets at UTC midnight while UI says 'come back tomorrow'
findings.fix_direction: Pass client local date.
findings.acceptance: Spec in TZ=Pacific/Auckland.

findings.title: 20260822180000_scheduler_state_requires_observation not applied (0 violating rows); devTools.js:29 still writes a reps-less learning card
findings.fix_direction: Fix devTools then apply per BACKLOG order.

findings.title: Undo writes back with unchecked bare update; grade online then undo offline leaves the undone grade on the server and the re-grade is refused on replay

findings.acceptance: Harness scenario converges.

findings.title: After a passed test the level-unlock and level-up writes are unchecked — results can say 'Perfect score' while unlock failed

findings.title: Achievements 'mastered' count uses stability only (bypasses shared isMastered rule)
